notes: Cliopatria has no Carchemish. The infobox (c. 1321) and the page text (siege and conquest c. 1345) disagree, and the hittites dossier (me-04-a) has 1327 from the Mitanni page; this dossier uses 1345. The Hittite shapes of -1300..-1200 draw Carchemish as direct Hittite land while the page treats it as a kingdom ruled by Piyassili, i.e. a vassal; the Hittite -1300 shape therefore needs the Carchemish district tinted as vassal. Assyrian tribute is dated only by Sangara's reign (before 868 on the Balawat Bands). Carchemish's relation to Til-Barsip, Bit-Adini and Arpad is not on any page opened, and the Syro-Hittite states page gave no dates for any state, so Sam'al, Gurgum, Kummuh and Melid were not written (see gaps). OVERLAP: the neo-hittite-states dossier (me-04-a, Cliopatria row -1150..-801 widened to -1180..-717) is the Carchemish hull and already carries Carchemish's own events from -1180 (found, tribute to Assyria from -868, fall in -717); this dossier splits Carchemish out as the brief allows and adds the Mitanni and Hittite-vassal phase from -1345, so from -1180 to -717 the two draw the same city and me-02 should keep only one of them for the Carchemish district. Page budget: four pages.
